title: Your Home Is Not a Piggy Bank
music: generated score at 120 BPM (1 bar = 2s), a chord per numbered rule
topic: HELOC rules: credit line secured by the home, 65%/80% limits, variable rate, interest-only, borrow with purpose, tax deductibility
hook: A HELOC is not free money.
logline: A calm narrator shows a homeowner that a HELOC is a credit line with their house as the collateral, and that the house is the one who pays when the rules are ignored.
structure: Rules card with a held presenter and a house that reacts. 0:00-0:34 setup (money rains on a grinning house, stamp says no, what a HELOC is, the 65%/80% wall), 0:34-1:28 three numbered rules each a medallion the camera irises through (variable rate, interest-only, borrow with purpose), 1:28-2:00 tax warning, homeowner on a mustard rotary phone, dead-still end card for 3s. Placeholder CTA 'Your Name · Mortgage Agent'.
device: the house as a second character with a face (grin, worry, sweat, sag, calm) plus numbered medallions the camera irises through; off-register cel colour; one ground colour per scene
rejectedStructures: straight explainer: eight cards in a row with nothing changing about the homeowner
before/after of one homeowner: adds a second story and pushes past two minutes
lessons: Longest reel (101s at 24 fps); later HELOC reels cut to about 55s at 30 fps.
Its end card is a dead-still 3s starburst with a placeholder CTA, not a loop.
